Magliana — Rome, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Magliana is a large postwar residential district historically infamous as the territory and namesake of the Banda della Magliana, Rome's dominant organized-crime gang of the 1970s-80s; that organization no longer exists in its historical form, though the neighborhood's association with it persists in popular memory. Current local press instead documents an active, lower-level drug trade: recent operations report arrests at a drug-dealing hub with a firearm and ammunition seized, a joint blitz against abusive squats and dealing, and a further decoro e sicurezza operation yielding arrests and citations. These are recurring, well-documented police actions against street-level dealing rather than 1980s-style organized violence, so the area functions as an ordinary residential quarter by day, with drug-dealing activity the main documented concern after dark.
